mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card (id, user_id, deck_id, front, back, example, hint, pronunciation, is_flagged, delete_batch_id, created_at, updated_at, server_version, last_device_id, deleted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{deckId}, #{front}, #{back}, #{example}, #{hint}, #{pronunciation}, #{flagged}, #{deleteBatchId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{serverVersion}, #{lastDeviceId}, NULL)
mapper.update: WITH numbered AS ( SELECT c.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.id) AS rn ) UPDATE card SET delete_batch_id = #{batchId}, server_version = #{firstVersion} + numbered.rn - 1, updated_at = #{now}, last_device_id = #{deviceId} FROM numbered WHERE card.id = numbered.id
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND delete_batch_id = #{batchId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
